ABOUT DJ STARKEY

DJ Starkey is a DJ based in Tilburg, Netherlands, bringing a blend of melodic electronic music, progressive energy and festival-inspired atmosphere to every performance.

His DJ sets move through Melodic House & Techno, Progressive House and EDM, with an emphasis on strong melodies, powerful builds and mainstage-style energy.

From intimate celebrations to larger events, the focus is on reading the room, building energy and creating a memorable experience for the audience.
